**Professional Experience**

Spearheaded the adoption of Redux Toolkit for state management, improving team productivity by streamlining complex form handling workflows. Redesigned the checkout flow with responsive design principles, resulting in a 15% increase in conversion rates.

Developed core UI components for a B2B e-commerce platform, focusing on cross-browser compatibility and accessibility compliance. Contributed to the implementation of a custom state management system using Zustand, reducing dependency on external libraries.
